crowdsec.config.apiKey.help: Output of "cscli bouncers add npmplus". Leave empty to keep the stored key.
crowdsec.config.appsecUrl.help: Leave empty to disable AppSec. Requires the appsec acquisition in CrowdSec.
crowdsec.config.description: Settings of the CrowdSec bouncer built into NPMplus (/data/crowdsec/crowdsec.conf). CrowdSec itself runs in its own container and reads the access log. Saving reloads nginx, no restart needed.
crowdsec.config.enabled.help: Block IPs with an active CrowdSec decision on all hosts (can be disabled per proxy host).
crowdsec.config.excludeLocation.help: Comma separated paths the bouncer ignores, e.g. /.well-known
crowdsec.config.machine.help: Needed to ban/unban IPs and read alerts. Create it with "cscli machines add npmplus-gui --auto -f -" and enter the login and password from the output.
crowdsec.config.mode.help: live: asks the local API per IP (cached). stream: keeps all decisions in memory.
crowdsec.config.sslVerify: Verify TLS certificates of the local API and AppSec
crowdsec.config.tls-auth: The bouncer authenticates with a TLS client certificate (USE_TLS_AUTH), the API key is not used.
crowdsec.machine-required: Banning, unbanning and alerts need a machine login, see Settings.
crowdsec.not-connected: NPMplus can not reach the CrowdSec local API or the bouncer key is not accepted.
crowdsec.setup.config: Enter the local API URL, the bouncer key and the machine login under Settings and enable the bouncer.
crowdsec.setup.container: Run the crowdsec container (see compose.yaml) with COLLECTIONS=ZoeyVid/npmplus and set LOGROTATE=true for NPMplus, the access log is mounted into the crowdsec container.
crowdsec.setup.intro: CrowdSec runs as its own container next to NPMplus:
crowdsec.setup.machine: Create a machine login for this page (optional, needed for ban/unban and alerts):
